title: Absolute Value Inequality
description: This one requires work. Use pencil and paper first, then graph the interval. :)
learningObjective: Students translate absolute-value inequalities into interval graphs on a number line.

feedback.defaultCorrect: Correct. The absolute-value inequality describes all values within that distance of the center.
feedback.defaultIncorrect: Not yet. Find the center and distance before graphing.
feedback.defaultEncouragement: Use pencil and paper first. For |x - h| <= r, graph the interval from h - r to h + r.

questions.prompt: Work it out first. Tap -2, drag the right ray handle, tap 4, then choose Done.

choices.label: I need to revise my graph

hints: This problem requires work. Use pencil and paper first.
Move 3 units left and 3 units right from 1.
Tap the endpoints -2 and 4 to make the interval.
questions.correctFeedback: The selected answer is correct. The graph score checks the interval [-2, 4].
questions.incorrectFeedback: The graph should include every x-value from -2 through 4.

hints: The strict inequality uses open endpoints.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Check the center, radius, and whether the endpoints are included.
